Bonferroni adjustment is applied over the predeclared lambda grid. Because gate-training folds overlap, this is not asserted to be a formal independent-fold confidence bound.

freeze_statement: The frozen pre-continuation ERM reference, every matched-continuation candidate head, validation score, cross-fitted certificate, chosen lambda, and transferable full-validation gate were frozen using only blind train/validation arrays. The reference was excluded from lambda selection. Waterbirds groups, backgrounds, the blind test split, and sealed metadata remained unopened.

frozen_erm_reference.certificate_score_role: diagnostic comparability only; adjusted on the 5-candidate scale but excluded from selection

protocol.analysis_status: post-hoc matched-control sensitivity designed after v1 Waterbirds group/test outcomes were inspected; not an independent held-out confirmation

head.candidate_checkpoint_metric: binary NLL at temperature 1; step zero is eligible

repair.candidate_seed_matching: one identical head-training seed for every lambda, including zero
repair.fisher_normalization: F_initial/(F_current+epsilon), equal to one at the warm start
repair.frozen_erm_reference: pre-continuation base ERM head; reported separately and excluded from selection
repair.lambda_zero: matched ERM continuation under the same optimizer and checkpoint rule
repair.objective: ERM plus lambda times dimensionless inverse Fisher on a frozen train-audit slice
repair.temperature: one ERM calibration temperature frozen across every candidate
repair.warm_start: same frozen ERM head for every lambda

selection.accuracy_diagnostic_role: diagnostic only; does not alter selection
selection.certificate: reciprocal one-sided upper score on mean held-out inverse Fisher
selection.crossfit_evidence: held-out metrics are evaluated on CPU; the selected gate for every fold and the deterministic fold assignment are archived so certification can replay each ranking statistic from validation rows
selection.crossfit_score_scope: validation ranking only; overlapping gate-training folds mean this is not presented as a formal independent-fold confidence interval
selection.paired_inverse_diagnostic_family: Bonferroni over the 4 predeclared positive-lambda versus matched-ERM comparisons
selection.paired_inverse_diagnostic_role: diagnostic only; overlapping discovery folds preclude a formal independent-fold test
selection.ranking: highest Bonferroni-adjusted cross-fit certificate lower score; exact ties choose the smaller lambda
selection.risk_envelope: within one per-example standard error of the validation-NLL minimizer
selection.simultaneous_correction: Bonferroni over the predeclared lambda grid

selection.criterion: one-SE validation-NLL envelope; then maximum Bonferroni-adjusted cross-fit certificate lower score with smaller-lambda tie break
